title: The exact three-spatial-dimensional equal-time Wick quartic has divergent fourth-chaos variance

declared_model.field: real centered Gaussian scalar field with conjugate Fourier modes
declared_model.covariance: q_k=(2 sqrt(m^2+|k|^2))^-1 with m>0; C_N(x-y)=sum_{k in K_N} q_k exp(ik dot (x-y))
declared_model.scope: equal-time Hamiltonian Gaussian control, not the Euclidean covariance and not a source-selected GU field measure

fourth_chaos_obstruction.martingale: For M>=N, E(V_M conditional on F_N)=V_N and E(V_N)=0
fourth_chaos_obstruction.variance_identity: Var(V_N)=24 integral C_N(z)^4 dz=24 sum_{k1+...+k4=0, ki in K_N} product_i q_ki
fourth_chaos_obstruction.cone: For 8 dividing N choose k1,k2,k3 componentwise in [N/8,N/4] and k4=-(k1+k2+k3); all four lie in K_N
fourth_chaos_obstruction.d3_consequence: In d=3 the lower bound grows at least as a positive constant times N^5, so the Wick martingale is not L2 bounded or L2 Cauchy
fourth_chaos_obstruction.lower_chaos_counterterms: For U_N=integral(phi_N^4+a_N phi_N^2+b_N), U_N-E U_N=V_N+(6C_N+a_N) integral :phi_N^2:, and orthogonality gives Var(U_N)>=Var(V_N)
fourth_chaos_obstruction.operator_ceiling: The result excludes an L2 multiplication-potential limit under deterministic local quadratic and vacuum counterterms. It does not exclude a renormalized closed quadratic form, free-Hamiltonian smoothing, coupling or field-strength renormalization, or an interacting resolvent construction
